'''Darluna''' is a large town in southern [[Arad Doman]].

==Appearance==
There is a twenty foot wall surrounding the town.

==Activities==
[[Rodel Ituralde]] plans a defense at Darluna. He hides most of his forces inside the buildings, letting only a small fraction of them out to work the fields around the town. This causes the [[Seanchan]] ''[[raken]]'' scouts to believe Darluna will be an easy win. When the Seanchan forces try to take the town, all of Ituralde's men burst from the building and defeat the Seanchan.{{ref/book|12|p}} Later, after the battle, over half of Ituralde's 100,000 men have died in defense of the town. The Seanchan commander, [[Lieutenant-General]] [[Turan]] commends Ituralde before Ituralde kills him.{{ref/book|12|6}}
